title: Graco Marks 100 Years at the NYSE Opening Bell Ceremony
body_markdown:
## Graco Marks 100 Years at the NYSE Opening Bell Ceremony


As Graco's centennial year comes to a close, the company marked the milestone with a visit to one of the world's most recognized financial institutions.


On Sept. 28, 2026, members of Graco leadership participated in the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE) Opening Bell ceremony on Wall Street. The event recognized Graco's 100 years of business and served as a moment to reflect on the company's history and future.


The occasion also marked another milestone for the company, which celebrates 40 years on the NYSE after first listing its stock in September 1986.


*Image courtesy of NYSE Group. NYSE does not recommend or endorse any investments, investment strategies, companies, products or services.*


The Opening Bell ceremony symbolizes the start of the trading day and the opportunities that come with it. For Graco, the occasion highlighted a century of innovation and the company's continued focus on serving customers around the world.


#### Built on innovation and entrepreneurship


Founded in Minneapolis in 1926, Graco has spent the past century developing technologies that move, measure, control, dispense and apply materials more efficiently. As manufacturing processes changed and new technologies became available, Graco expanded its capabilities to help customers in more markets, including:


- [Homeowner](https://www.graco.com/us/en/homeowner/products.html)
- [Contractor](https://www.graco.com/us/en/contractor/products.html)
- [Service and Repair](https://www.graco.com/us/en/vehicle-service/products.html)
- [Manufacturing](https://www.graco.com/us/en/in-plant-manufacturing/products.html)


Over the past 100 years, the company has evolved alongside the industries it serves:


- **1920s:** Lubrication equipment and grease guns designed to simplify routine maintenance
- **1950s:** Expansion into industrial pumps, fluid handling and paint spraying equipment
- **1960s-1980s:** Development of controls, automation, electrostatic technology and contractor equipment
- **2000s:** Growth into retail and home-center markets
- **2010s-2020s:** Advancements in cordless, electric and digitally controlled equipment, along with expansion into new technologies and markets


From introducing[its first air-powered grease gun](https://www.graco.com/us/en/about-graco/news/articles/2026/q1/the-invention-of-the-air-powered-grease-gun.html) to developing today's broad portfolio, Graco's approach has remained the same: identify customer challenges and develop solutions to solve them.


"For 100 years, our success has been tied to helping customers improve the way they work," said Mark Sheahan, president and CEO of Graco. "As industries have evolved, so have we."


#### Looking ahead to the next century


The NYSE Opening Bell ceremony closes a year of celebrations recognizing the people, products and milestones that have shaped Graco's first 100 years. As Graco enters its next chapter, the company remains focused on advancing technologies, supporting customers and building upon the foundation that defined its first century.


[Read more](https://www.graco.com/us/en/about-graco/100.html) about Graco's 100-year history and the innovation and ingenuity that continue to shape its future.
